SCENE 2 - DETECT THE LAUNCH CONSTRAINT
Spot the product-launch risk before it fragments across teams.
The command center turns a constrained Al accelerator launch into one operating view: fab utilization, wafer-start plans,
yield risk, supplier shortage exposure, design-to-manufacturing handoff readiness, channel inventory, contract
manufacturing capacity, customer commitments, order-promising pressure, connected-product signals, field quality,
warranty exposure, and support backlog surface together.
Use Your Own Product Data
Start with cross-functional status cards and exception lists.
Look for linked fab, supplier, quality, warranty, support, and customer pressure.
Use the dashboard as the handoff into signals, graph, map, analytics, Ask Data, and
agents.
Capacity pressure • 15%
Recent requested units compared with available units
across the product network.
Supply flexibility • 5%
Added exposure when only one or two supply sites have
units avallable for allocation.
How the launch constraint is detected
Products are flagged when demand signals accelerate while supply
flexibility tightens. The same inputs shown below are combined into a
transparent 0-100 Constraint Risk score; higher scores indicate greater
launch exposure.
Demand signal pressure - 80%
45% average virality, up to 20% signal concentration.
and up to 15% matched-record volume.
